subject.title: [Bug]: macOS app 'Launch at login' stops sticking / appears to turn itself off after app updates

question: Should the macOS app persist OpenClaw-owned Launch at login intent and repair app-owned LaunchAgent drift after updates, or should live launchd/System Settings state remain authoritative?
rationale: Current code makes live launchd state authoritative, while the requested fix would preserve enabled user intent across app replacement/update and could change how OpenClaw treats external disables.

options.title: Persist intent and reconcile app-owned drift
options.body: Store explicit in-app enabled intent and re-register only OpenClaw-owned LaunchAgent drift after startup/update with guards for deliberate external disables.

options.title: Keep launchd authoritative
options.body: Leave live launchd/System Settings state as the source of truth and document that OpenClaw will not restore externally disabled login items.

options.title: Wait for packaged update proof
options.body: Keep the issue parked until a signed current-main Sparkle-style update repro identifies the exact state that flips.

recommendation.title: Persist intent and reconcile app-owned drift
recommendation.body: Store explicit in-app enabled intent and re-register only OpenClaw-owned LaunchAgent drift after startup/update with guards for deliberate external disables.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for the original launchd-backed checkbox path and current macOS app ownership is steipete.
